title: Codex shell_command harness gap -- analysis and fix spec
desc: Codex shell_command tool flows through wkharness but bypasses all guards -- gap analysis and one-line fix.
steps: FINDING: Every Codex shell_command reaches wkharness via config.toml PreToolUse matcher='.*'. Infrastructure is in place.

GAP-1 harnessBody switch: shell_command hits 'default { raw }' branch. _harnessInput becomes full JSON string, not the command. harness:block pattern 'git push --force' does NOT match JSON-encoded content.
GAP-2 guards: toolName -in (Bash,PS) checks exclude shell_command. pace-guard, spec-gate, cd-noise-guard, skill-news-guard all pass silently for Codex.
GAP-3 file tools: apply_patch (1823 calls, 8.6%) already blocked by harness:block in CLAUDE.md. write_file/read_file rarely used.

FIX (one line): in wkharness-guards.ps1 switch(toolName) add case 'shell_command' { cmd } between PS and default. Then _harnessInput = bullet shell_command(actual command text). All harness:block patterns fire for Codex identically to Claude.
EXTEND: change toolName -in (Bash,PS) to toolName -in (Bash,PS,shell_command) in all guards for full parity.
COVERAGE: 95pct+ of Codex tool calls under harness control after fix (shell_command 86.6% + apply_patch blocked 8.6%).
STATS 551 sessions: top cmds Get-Content 4638, git 2347, wkappbot 2089, Get-ChildItem 1962, rg 1694.
author: claude
